Follow up with Preacher and Floodpits Drowner as mana allows; watch for removal (Go for the Throat, Cut Down, Anoint with Affliction) on Sheoldred.

event_vocabulary: they_cast:<card name | removal | counter | creature | any>

response.why: Their Sheoldred can freely block and kill Enduring Curiosity for no cost (5 toughness survives 4 damage) since it's still summoning sick but can block, so attacking now is a bad trade. Better to add Preacher of the Schism as a deathtouch blocker that trades evenly with Sheoldred next turn, and hold my full board back to defend at 7-7 life.
response.plan: Sheoldred is now theirs and very dangerous - each card I draw costs me 2 life, so avoid unnecessary draws (be cautious with Enduring Curiosity triggers) until I can remove or trade with it. Preacher's deathtouch lets me trade profitably with Sheoldred if they attack; keep Enduring Curiosity and Floodpits Drowner back as additional blockers rather than risk them into an unfavorable block.
